clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, The Legend of Stalvan now rests on proof in muddy journal pages. Tavernkeep Smitts gives them to you and sends you to Commander Althea Ebonlocke.

Tavernkeep Smitts and Marshal Haggard once investigated the slaughter of a visiting noble family in Duskwood. Haggard was then a leader of the Stormwind Guard. They found torn, muddy journal pages at the scene, but had no handwriting samples or other papers to confirm who wrote them. The notes could not formally implicate the recluse rumored to live in the wilderness. Now, evidence gathered across Elwynn, Westfall, and Duskwood links the handwriting to Stalvan Mistmantle. The rumors have become proof of murder.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I followed the legend of that Stalvan character for years. When those visiting nobles were slaughtered a few years back I went with Haggard to investigate. I found these muddy pages but we were never able to link the handwriting to that crazy man in the woods. Your trail of evidence proves his guilt. Take this to Commander Ebonlocke immediately and fill her in on what you've discovered!

clips.title: Progress
paras: This better be good, adventurer. Let me see what you have and tell me your tale. But by the Light, be quick about it. Darkshire's defense is my number one priority. I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My, you have proved yourself to be quite a detective, adventurer.
